text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On that day, people saw the light.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of "Special Week"...! She 
hasn't lost a single step, but still—!)

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: "Teacher Cesario! Do your beeeest!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! I will...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Spe
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying dreams, brilliance, and the 
future— a blue light flashing past the 
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just as we thought—! Cesario takes the 
victoryyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!! Amazing, amazing, she 
really did it!! Cesarioooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...! It was amazing, so bright and 
dazzling!!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I want to become just like you too, 
Cesario-sensei!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I lost. It really stings after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You've got a great look on your 
face!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (The stands... are so dazzling—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, that gaze...)

text_block_list.name: Mother's Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, amazing, so amazing! Teacher, 
that was incredibleee!!

text_block_list.name: Young Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that's a true Umamusume...! The 
brilliance... of the Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm Rhein Kraft! My dream is to become a 
great Tiara Umamusume just like my 
senpais!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (What I saw that day—)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aweeeeeeeeeeeesome!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Trainer)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful, deep bow upon the 
sun-drenched turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her that day was etched long, 
long into the memories of many young 
Umamusume.
